rules.text: A ferry landing requires one local crossing anchor; a boat is not inferred from the crossing record.
rules.basis: transport:trv_011; book:624953 §Глава 6 Средства передвижения А.С. Хорошев ¶1224

rules.text: A peasant homestead requires one dwelling selected from its building mix.
A peasant homestead requires one enclosure; its candidate mix does not establish historical frequency.
Outbuildings require one economic building selected from locally applicable owner types.
A winter ice crossing requires one seasonal route anchor in winter.
